mentions.name: Music Mastering Fingerprinting Tool
mentions.description: This project develops an audio fingerprinting method that identifies which mastering of an album a recording is — like Shazam, but for telling what version of an album you have. It enables comparing measurements to determine what mastering you are actually getting, and plans a community fingerprint database/tool sitting between MusicBrainz and Discogs so the community can standardize and quantify mastering information.
mentions.problem: Remasters and stealth replacements on streaming silently degrade or remove favorite music, and mastering version information only lives ad hoc in forum threads or partially on sites like the loudness-war database.
mentions.audience: Music collectors and audiophiles who want to track, compare, and collect specific mastering versions of albums
